title: Prioritizing Technical Debt as if Time & Money Matters • Adam Tornhill • GOTO 2019
summary: Adam Tornhill's GOTO Copenhagen 2019 talk on how to prioritize technical debt in large codebases. It argues for combining code complexity with change frequency (hotspots) from version control data, rather than trying to quantify debt in the abstract.
why: Cited as a practical approach to finding the technical debt that matters, and as a reference for codebase visualization.

quote.text: I think Adam Tornhill has a nice take on this.
